label: Pure Python domain policy and SLA constants
instruction: Generate only modules/complaint_cms/domain/policy.py as a compact PURE-PYTHON module (max 45 lines). Domain modules must not import Django, DRF, ORM models or Celery. Export COMPLAINT_STATUSES tuple, SEVERITY_SLA_HOURS dict (Mapping low/medium/high/critical to default SLA hours), ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS dict mapping each complaint status to a set of allowed next statuses, can_transition(current_status, next_status) bool helper, and default_sla_hours(severity, fallback_hours=48) int helper. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
